caption: The drawing depicts a garment, likely a loose-fitting cloak or poncho, which is illustrated predominantly in shades of pale blue and white. The garment appears to be sleeveless and gathered at the neckline, with a prominent tie or ribbon extending from the neck area. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a simpler outline sketch of the same garment, shown without pattern details and using only black lines.
